Model preference: open to Redwood-curated smaller models with streaming + quantized variants; want fallback to cheaper model on load.

Integration notes: using React + websockets, will integrate Redwood streaming endpoint. Prefers SDK for JS with built-in reconnects and partial updates.
Risk: small engineering team, POC must be low-friction. Prefer self-serve docs + 1-2 SE hours vs full professional services.
